character: 3.27-mile (5.26km) undulating Virginia road course regarded as one of America's most technical circuits. The uphill Climbing Esses and the downhill Roller Coaster complex are the signature sections; a clean run through the Climbing Esses sets up the rest of the lap.
sources: https://hotlaprentals.com/articles/virginia-international-raceway-vir-complete-track-guide-master-americas-most-versatile-racing-circuit ; https://www.tarheelbmwcca.org/virnorthhotlap.pdf — Climbing Esses/Oak Tree/Roller Coaster/Hog Pen verified

corners.name: Turn 1
corners.type: heavy-braking right-hander off the front straight
corners.trap: Over-braking and losing momentum into the following section

corners.name: Climbing Esses
corners.type: uphill left-right-left sequence (Turns 7-9) taken at high entry speed
corners.technique: Commit through the blind crests, smooth steering, let the car settle over each crest
corners.trap: Braking or lifting mid-sequence unsettles the car on the elevation changes

corners.name: Roller Coaster
corners.type: downhill compression sequence (Turns 13-15) with three pronounced humps
corners.technique: Stay smooth and committed as the car goes light over each hump
corners.trap: Excess speed or a poor line here risks significant airtime

corners.name: Hog Pen
corners.type: tight chicane (Turns 16-17) before the front straight
corners.technique: Hard, precise braking, quick direction change
corners.trap: Carrying too much speed in and running out of track on exit
